An exclusive release in this platform between both versions. One is the official (in proper from the source) and a textless variant. Pubic is also included in some pages.

Dreams do come true with this shipping comic of PhinBella. It was purchased and direct from a SubStar source (formerly moved via Pixiv Fanbox due to political issues in Japan) up until the 11th page. Baraag and/or Pixiv's public feed will follow after as needed. Translations in this comic are also welcome, with artist consultation first.

Consider donating commission pages to finish love story comic. It may be slower than usual so, new pages updated monthly. We strongly encourage to SUPPORT the OFFICIAL RELEASE and was yet to be finished as early by 2026.

Thank you.

QUICK UPDATE (as of 5:00pm - June 28th, 2023): Due to a popular demand, this PhinBella comic had now moved from a current release pages a month later or two. Albeiting to switch back, the public way via Pixiv or Baraag in early July. Full info in the 2nd comment update from our distribution team.
